title: Editor, Lore Links & Contradiction Integration
claim_boundary: Local contract and integration evidence only; native GUI, hosted CI, hardware, signing, and public release remain unverified.

link_round_trip.mechanism: InlineLoreLinkParser and InlineLoreLinkRenderer preserve prose, escaped syntax, and valid links byte-for-byte.

backlink_consistency.mechanism: Backlinks and integrity scans use the project-scoped scene source set, classify resolved/broken/ambiguous targets, and exclude foreign scenes.

source_citations.mechanism: Contradiction findings retain ordered source citations and render deterministic explanations.

incremental_analysis.mechanism: ContradictionAnalysisPipeline scopes evaluation to requested subject IDs, skips invalid rules fail-closed, and preserves stable fingerprints.

repair_flow.mechanism: Retarget repairs only inline link segments; contradiction inbox resolve/dismiss/restore keeps shared dismissal state and does not mutate manuscript text.
